nodes.name: Webhook POST chat-to-slack
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/chat-to-slack with body {source: 'facilitator'|'ai', text}. ModelLogue's chatStore invokes this fire-and-forget on facilitator turns and AI replies (SR-132).

nodes.name: Slack Post Message
nodes.notes: Posts to the channel given by SLACK_RELAY_CHANNEL_ID. Bot Scope required: chat:write. Bot must already be a member of the channel.
